checkpoints.description: grounding: read P007 and its enforcement

[1/2] CLI requires full impact (4 fields, risks labelled contract/dependency/concurrency/state) on a task's first plan checkpoint; lazy-code gate in update_knowledge_base.py; tests; README/help; ADR-079; [2/2] rewrite P007 R1-R6 + capsule; pins; ADR-080

impact_assessment.why: P007 duties were judgement calls; R6 ledger record skipped all session; R3 contradicts P000 R5
impact_assessment.benefits: every model records the same assessment; stubs and unnamed suppressions fail a gate
impact_assessment.risks: contract: --checkpoint exits 2 for a plan without impact, update_knowledge_base fails on lazy code; dependency: none, stdlib tokenize/ast; concurrency: none; state: ledger schema unchanged, impact_assessment already exists
impact_assessment.mitigation: enforce only on the first plan checkpoint so revisions stay light; exempt Protocol/abstract/overload bodies; red-green tests

checkpoints.description: [1/1] rewrite P008 R1-R6 decidably (delegation limits, milestone order by symbol use, M>6 splits into tasks, milestone = one P009 layer + tests, re-plan = new [1/M'] checkpoint, sub-agents never write the ledger); shared data-driven unambiguity test; ADR-081

impact_assessment.why: P008 uses banned words, Pillar B has two readings, R5 contradicts P004 R1, R6 conflicts with ADR-077 superseded logic
impact_assessment.benefits: one reading of decomposition for every model; no ledger corruption by sub-agents
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rule text only; dependency: none; concurrency: sub-agent ledger writes forbidden, removes a conflict; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: pins fail on old text; cross-principle ADR line from --citing

checkpoints.description: [1/1] architecture gate in update_knowledge_base.py (junk-drawer module names, import cycles, Protocol/ABC with 0 or >5 methods); rewrite P009 with explicit scope (universal checks vs pluggable boundaries); README/help; ADR-082

impact_assessment.why: P009 scope undefined: read literally it condemns AIKit's own modules; only some parts decidable
impact_assessment.benefits: one reading of where layering applies; the decidable parts gated for adopters too
impact_assessment.risks: contract: update_knowledge_base exits 1 on new conditions; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: AIKit passes unchanged; unit tests with fixtures; README rows and --help updated
